'''challenger Prototype HB''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 1 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 HB challenger LS 2003 Prototyp 5115.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Prototype form, please don’t rate harshly because of small strategy section. Please only review if you understand HB.

The published list has 57 cards.

== Strategy ==

You know what it is. Systems, flip, drain, cancel drains, and do one-turn Kessel Runs. DWTE (V) rules DS, Eject! Eject! Rules ZiMH, DiPO, or Boba In Slave I, combine DoRF with the Bacta Tank and you can lose a matching pilot/ship then get ‘em back.
